it.txt: Era vice-prefeito e tomou posse como prefeito em 27/03/2026, em sessão solene da Câmara Municipal, depois que Allyson Bezerra renunciou ao cargo para concorrer a governador na eleição de 2026.
it.txt_en: He was vice mayor and was sworn in as mayor on March 27, 2026, in a formal session of the City Council, after Mayor Allyson Bezerra resigned to run for governor in the 2026 election.
